items.markdown:
![Bang Tao Beach Phuket – Luxury, Calm & Vibrant Beach Life](https://api.dataforseo.com/cdn/i/07271404-1672-0139-0000-b22015b10620:4)
Bang Tao Beach is `a 6-kilometer long white-sand destination on Phuket's west coast` featuring luxury resorts like [Banyan Tree Phuket](https://www.banyantree.com/thailand/phuket) , popular beach clubs like Catch Beach Club , and local markets.[](https://www.phuket101.net/bang-tao-beach/) [[1]](https://www.phuket101.net/bang-tao-beach/)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/OB9vAl7JVBw)[[3]](https://www.cassia.com/thailand/cassia-phuket/article/bang-tao-beach)

Key Features & Layout

- **Southern & Central Sections:** Busy areas featuring beach chairs (100–500 Baht rentals), local restaurants, water sports, and the upscale Laguna Phuket resort complex.
- **Northern Section:** Quieter, undeveloped zones with natural pine tree shade and peaceful wading areas.
- **Inland Attractions:** Shopping and dining hubs like Boat Avenue and weekly night markets.[](https://www.tripadvisor.co.uk/Attraction_Review-g293920-d592496-Reviews-Bang_Tao_Beach-Phuket.html) [[1]](https://www.tripadvisor.co.uk/Attraction_Review-g293920-d592496-Reviews-Bang_Tao_Beach-Phuket.html)[[2]](https://www.firstchoice.co.uk/holiday/location/overview/Bang-Tao-L27404)[[3]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=o9I9eFO-3sU&t=24)[[4]](https://www.tui.co.uk/destinations/asia/thailand/phuket/bang-tao/holidays-bang-tao.html)[[5]](https://www.onthebeach.co.uk/hotels/thailand/phuket/bang-tao-bay/sunwing-bang-tao-beach)
